conditions: API requires an operator-defined height polygon; video does not measure height.
Person must be inside that polygon with a fresh assigned no_harness observation above object_confidence.
Common FSM requires >=75% weighted evidence and >=3 fresh timestamps; unknown cannot confirm or clear.
Leaving height context may close the contextual violation, without establishing a worn harness.
patterns.structural_result: Negative No_Harness exists; missing-harness activation is possible. No harness/safety_harness output exists, so observed worn confirmation inside height context is unavailable from this model.
patterns.semantic_limit: Fitting, attachment, anchors and physical working height are not measured.
patterns.real_positive_acceptance_gap: Inventory has repeated still no_harness-demo.mp4 / harness-unambiguous.jpg, no verified moving at-height positive/negative pair. Ground-level people carrying straps are not such truth.

conditions: Equipment association uses same label, IoU>.1 and gap<.8s. Image displacement history spans >=.3s.
Autonomous branch requires equipment image speed/person.height>=.05 and person-foot distance to its bottom segment <=.6 person-heights by default, or <=3m with explicit floor homography.
Alternative bool(best or zone): occupancy of equipment polygon alone can activate, without detected/moving machinery.
patterns.structural_result: Some machinery alerts and zone-only alerts can fire. No dedicated forklift class exists; related machinery misclassification is possible but not validation.
patterns.semantic_limit: Uncalibrated image distance is not metres; polygon occupancy is not autonomous measurement of dangerous proximity.
patterns.real_positive_acceptance_gap: Inventory forklift-flare clip shows people/vehicle but has no calibrated distance/motion or dangerous-proximity event labels; no verified threshold-specific positive/negative pair.

inventory_positive_sources.meaning: Moving forklift and people visible; no calibrated hazard-distance truth

inventory_negative_sources.meaning: No moving supported machine near workers, requires source review

conditions: Shoulder/hip keypoints confidence >=.4; torso angle against image vertical is 40-75 degrees.
Assigned handbag/suitcase is within .2 person-height of an observed wrist.
Base normalized person speed>.1, followed by the temporal FSM.
patterns.structural_result: A box-only industrial load cannot satisfy the required carried-object-label branch under correct classification. Suitcase/handbag positives are possible. Hallucinating a box as a suitcase is not support.
patterns.semantic_limit: No arbitrary industrial box recognition, mass, knee/lifting ergonomics or load-transfer assessment.
patterns.real_positive_acceptance_gap: Inventory box-slip clip has a cardboard box, no unsafe-lifting ergonomics labels and no verified video pair satisfying the implemented carried-object predicate.

inventory_positive_sources.meaning: Person carries industrial cardboard box and slips; not labelled unsafe-lifting ergonomics

inventory_negative_sources.meaning: Normal work, no established carried-load posture labels

models_when_tested_alone: person/pose pipeline; no dedicated running classifier
conditions: Foot trajectory linear regression uses >=3 samples spanning >=.4s in a roughly 1s history.
Default speed threshold 1.25 person-heights/s or 2.5m/s with explicit planar floor calibration.
Temporal FSM confirms sustained evidence; fast_motion is explicit opt-in, default false.
patterns.structural_result: Functional speed-threshold rule; no running/unsafe-motion class is required or used. CPU unit tests demonstrate geometry, not real-video model quality.
patterns.semantic_limit: Camera movement, perspective, box jitter and height normalization affect image speed. Correct calibration is required for metres.
patterns.real_positive_acceptance_gap: Inventory forklift-flare running-away clip is sampled only; no isolated current-cascade positive/negative result or calibrated speed ground truth from this audit.

inventory_positive_sources.meaning: People visibly run away when forklift flares; onset samples only

models_when_tested_alone: person/pose pipeline; no extra object model selected
conditions: Person foot inside operator polygon of kind barrier.
Same track/context must first be observed outside; first appearance inside stays unknown until an outside observation.
zone_hold and common temporal FSM confirm sustained evidence.
patterns.structural_result: Operator-zone rule can fire. Missing object vocabulary does not make polygon occupancy impossible. Construction barricade class is not consumed by this rule.
patterns.semantic_limit: Physical barrier and whether the region is forbidden are operator declarations, not independently recognized hazards.
patterns.real_positive_acceptance_gap: No independent moving positive/negative pair with actual structure/forbidden-region and entry/exit timing labels in inventory. Arbitrarily drawing a polygon around a worker tests mechanics only.

generic_polygon_mechanics_sources.meaning: Controlled polygon containing a visible foot can test rule mechanics
